description: Defines the TransportParameters struct and related classes for QUIC's transport layer, including serialization, parsing, and validation functions.

classes.name: TransportParameters
classes.description: Contains parameters exchanged during the QUIC TLS handshake, with methods for validation, serialization, and logging.

classes.name: TransportParameters::IntegerParameter
classes.description: Represents a variable-length integer transport parameter with validation and serialization methods.

classes.name: TransportParameters::PreferredAddress
classes.description: Holds network address and connection ID info for server-sent preferred address transport parameter.

classes.name: TransportParameters::LegacyVersionInformation
classes.description: Represents Google QUIC downgrade prevention info, ported to QUIC+TLS.

classes.name: TransportParameters::VersionInformation
classes.description: Holds version info for downgrade prevention and version negotiation.

methods.name: TransportParameters::AreValid
methods.description: Validates transport parameters according to the specification.

methods.name: TransportParameters::ToString
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string representation of the transport parameters.

methods.name: TransportParameters::IntegerParameter::set_value
methods.description: Sets the value of the integer transport parameter.

methods.name: TransportParameters::IntegerParameter::value
methods.description: Returns the current value of the integer transport parameter.

methods.name: TransportParameters::IntegerParameter::IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current value of the parameter is valid.

methods.name: TransportParameters::IntegerParameter::Write
methods.description: Serializes the integer parameter into a QuicDataWriter.

methods.name: TransportParameters::IntegerParameter::Read
methods.description: Deserializes the integer parameter from a QuicDataReader.

methods.name: TransportParameters::PreferredAddress::ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the preferred address.

methods.name: TransportParameters::LegacyVersionInformation::ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the legacy version info.

methods.name: TransportParameters::VersionInformation::ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the version info.
